import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

data = [
("Department of Transportation and Infrastructure",114),
("Ministry of Health and Long-Term Care",240),
("Office of the Auditor General",742),

("Ministry of Social Development and Poverty Reduction",620),
("Department of Northern Affairs",390),
("Office of the Seniors Advocate",278),
("Ministry of Mental Health and Addictions",475),
]
labels = [d[0] for d in data]
vals = [d[1] for d in data]
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12,6))
ax.bar(range(len(vals)), vals, color='#2a9d8f')
ax.set_xticks(range(len(vals)))
ax.set_xticklabels(labels, rotation=60, ha='right', fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel('IT budget (thousand $)')
ax.set_ylim(0, max(vals)*1.1)
ax.set_title('IT budget by department')
fig.subplots_adjust(bottom=0.28)
fig.savefig('figure.png', dpi=100)
